text: In 2024, the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) and the DICT rolled out the Digital National ID. Aside from the national ID website, through which government mobile application can registered PhilSys holders access it?
PhilHealth launched YAKAP (Yaman ng Kalusugan Program) on July 25, 2025 as its revitalized primary care benefit package. It is an evolution of which earlier PhilHealth package?
The Department of Health's Zero Balance Billing policy, declared nationwide after the July 28, 2025 State of the Nation Address, means patients pay no hospital bill for which of the following?
optionA: Private rooms in any government or private hospital
optionB: All admissions in PhilHealth-accredited private hospitals
optionD: Outpatient consultations in LGU rural health units only

text: The DOH opened the first BUCAS center in Sto. Tomas, Pampanga in March 2024 to provide urgent and outpatient care without hospital admission. What does BUCAS stand for?
optionA: Barangay Urgent Care and Ambulance Service
optionB: Bagong Universal Clinic and Ambulatory Support
optionC: Bayanihan Urgent Care and Assistance Service
optionD: Bagong Urgent Care and Ambulatory Service

text: Under DepEd Order No. 10, s. 2024, the MATATAG Curriculum began its phased implementation in School Year 2024-2025 in which grade levels?

MULA (Multispectral Unit for Land Assessment), the Philippines' biggest satellite yet at about 130 kilograms, is being built by the Philippine Space Agency together with a satellite company from which country?
What is the theme of the Philippines' 2026 ASEAN Chairmanship, launched on November 14, 2025?
The 48th ASEAN Summit, the first leaders' summit under the Philippines' 2026 chairship, was held on May 8, 2026 in which city?
Which country takes over the ASEAN Chairmanship from the Philippines for 2027?
At the 47th ASEAN Summit in Kuala Lumpur on October 26, 2025, which country was formally admitted as ASEAN's 11th member state?

On July 8, 2024, the Philippines signed a Reciprocal Access Agreement (RAA) in Manila that allows each country's forces to enter the other's territory for joint military exercises. With which country was it signed?

On November 14, 2026, during the 28th ASEAN Economic Community Council Meeting in Manila, ASEAN member states signed the bloc's first standalone, legally binding agreement setting common rules on digital trade, cross-border data flows and electronic payments. What is it?
On December 9, 2024, PHIVOLCS raised Alert Level 3 after an explosive summit eruption sent a plume about 3,000 meters high, prompting evacuations within a 6-kilometer radius. Which volcano erupted?
PHIVOLCS identified which newly named fault as the source of the magnitude 6.9 earthquake that struck offshore northern Cebu on September 30, 2025, the strongest recorded in the province?

The magnitude 7.4 earthquake offshore Manay, Davao Oriental on October 10, 2025, which prompted a tsunami warning for eastern coastal provinces, originated along which structure according to PHIVOLCS?
In July 2024, the Philippines was selected from eight country offers to host the Board of which international climate fund?
optionD: Fund for Responding to Loss and Damage

text: The Philippines hosted the 2024 Asia-Pacific Ministerial Conference on Disaster Risk Reduction (APMCDRR) at the PICC in October 2024 in partnership with which United Nations office?
optionA: UN Office for Disaster Risk Reduction (UNDRR)
optionC: UN Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) Secretariat

text: Republic Act No. 12079, signed in December 2024, amended the National Internal Revenue Code to give a VAT refund on goods bought in the Philippines to which group?
optionA: Overseas Filipino workers on home vacation
optionB: Non-resident foreign tourists who take the goods out of the country
optionC: Senior citizens and persons with disabilities
optionD: Registered export enterprises in economic zones

text: In February 2025, the Philippines was removed from the 'grey list' of jurisdictions under increased monitoring, after being listed since June 2021. Which international body maintains this list?
optionB: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development

text: Under Batas Pambansa Blg. 72, how did the results of the 2024 Census of Population (POPCEN) conducted by the PSA become official for all purposes?
optionA: By approval of Congress through a joint resolution
optionB: By certification of the Commission on Elections
optionC: By publication of the results on the PSA website

text: The BSP unveiled the P500, P100 and P50 notes of the First Philippine Polymer Banknote Series in December 2024, each featuring native wildlife. Which animal appears on the P500 polymer note?
At the Paris 2024 Olympics, Carlos Yulo became the first Filipino to win two Olympic gold medals. In which events did he win them?
optionB: Men's pommel horse and still rings
optionC: Men's parallel bars and horizontal bar
optionD: Men's individual all-around and floor exercise

text: Besides Carlos Yulo's two golds, the Philippines won two bronze medals in boxing at the Paris 2024 Olympics, its best-ever Olympic haul. Who won them?
In August 2026, Alex Eala came from a set down to beat top seed Jessica Pegula, 4-6, 6-4, 6-0, and win her first-ever WTA 500 singles title. Which tournament did she win?

Which Lav Diaz film, starring Gael Garcia Bernal and premiered in the Cannes Premiere section in May 2025, was chosen as the Philippines' official entry for Best International Feature Film at the 98th Academy Awards?
